sourcePrompt: Four-second vertical front-camera iPhone selfie video. Two adult female friends sit shoulder to shoulder at a small outdoor amusement park café table, both close to the camera and visible from chest up. One has dark hair and a pale pink bow headband; the other has wavy brown hair and a silver-blue bow headband. Each holds a different round chocolate-covered treat on a stick near the center of the frame. The woman on the left gently brings her treat beside her friend’s; the treats touch lightly. They exchange a quick glance, smile, then look toward the camera. Their movements overlap naturally rather than happening in sync. Colorful striped awning behind them, candid phone framing, daylight, one continuous four-second take. No bite, speech, captions, branded characters, or exaggerated reaction.
